note: Polk County Conservation park on 197 acres along Camp Creek near Mitchellville, ~5 mi east of Des Moines off I-80. Construction to expand the campsites is under way (county notice, read 2026-11-02). --Claude
summary: Changed count 35 -> 31 (2026 map), added $25 and the 14-in-17 limit. Confirmed 20/30/50 electric, showers, dump, Apr 1-Nov 30, reserve-only on MyCountyParks. Added potable water (hydrant). Pin ~135 m from the loop.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, unproved): stored 'not waterfront', but the county's 2026 map draws Camp Creek against the west side of the loop behind sites 15-21, with no road between, and sites 24-25 close to it on the south. Imagery at 41.6393,-93.3815 shows a dark channel under canopy ~15-20 m behind the pad at about 41.6398,-93.3817, nothing clearer. Creek is under 30 m wide, so `creekside` at most, for the west row only. Canopy hides the water and no campsite photo was read, so I left it down. Overpass timed out, so distances are imagery estimates.
